JOB TITLE: Analytical Rules Developer
Waukesha, Wisconsin 
1 Year 

• *In summary statement, please speak to the candidates experience in taking the lead in a project and showing the ability to make decisions/ explore options/ analyze and trouble shoot.
• Minimum 5yr programing experience in Java and Python
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, ability to explore options, make decisions.
• Project leadership
• Ability to work independently and with a small team (5-10 people)
• Design documentation exp.
• Matlab is a requirement
Job Duties: 1. Gather requirements by communicating directly with stakeholders 2. Develop and update documentation of user and system requirements 3. Build and maintain code libraries/toolkits to support analytics frameworks 4. Develop intelligent algorithms for descriptive, predictive and prescriptive analytics 5. Perform unit testing and code reviews 6. Troubleshoot issues by identifying the root cause and suggesting solutions 7. Develop new ideas with proof-of-concept (POCs)



 
 Thanks & Regards,

SR.IT Recruiter

Sandra Taylor 

571-267-4186
